recap.text: Before Donut puts on her new cloak, Mordecai hands her a potion he has just made, once called Charisma Cheat and now called MySpace Photo. It tricks the system into reading her base Charisma as 193 instead of 163, so the cloak raises her Constitution to 193 instead of 163, for two minutes. Donut drinks it, earns a very rude Catfish achievement, and the cloak appears over her shoulders, so short it is like a shawl.

beats.headline: Catfishing the system
beats.text: Before Donut puts on her new cloak, Mordecai pulls out a potion he has just made. It used to be called Charisma Cheat, but the system now calls it MySpace Photo. It tricks the system into thinking her base Charisma is 193 instead of 163, so that when she puts the cloak on it will raise her Constitution to 193 instead of 163 in time. That is why he wanted her to wait, and it lasts two minutes. From a base Constitution of two, Carl says, that is almost Katia-level resilience. Donut drinks it, gets a very rude Catfish achievement, and the cloak appears over her shoulders, so short on her it is like a shawl.
beats.gist: Donut drinks Mordecai's MySpace Photo, which fakes her Charisma at 193, so her cloak lifts Constitution higher.

relations.note: drunk just before the cloak went on, to raise the stat it matches
